cohort: 100 Greek girls aged 7-17 years with menarche and no chronic disease or medication use
finding: This Greek sample demonstrated a relatively young age at menarche with a significant proportion of girls with early menarche; in the latter group, the rate of caesarian sections was significantly higher than controls.
mod_finding: The rate of caesarian sections was significantly higher in girls with early menarche compared to controls.
birth_weight: Mentioned as recorded but no details given
